reasons_bola_missed: Schemathesis fuzzes single API endpoints independently and does not maintain dual-user state.
Lacks cross-user authorization oracle (does not compare user Alice resource owner vs user Bob accessor).
Returns HTTP 200 on GET /orders/{order_id} which matches documented 200 response schema, so Schemathesis treats it as a success.

comparison_summary.key_distinction: Schemathesis excels at rapid fuzzing for 5xx server crashes and schema contract mismatches. However, Schemathesis cannot detect BOLA (OWASP API1:2023) because the vulnerable endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK with valid schema, requiring multi-user session management and object ownership oracles which only the Autonomous AI Testing Agent provides.
